dedupe_keys.name: servicio wms web map service red de canales principales

description: Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Red de canales principales is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). The WMS Service (Web Map Service) called Network of main channels allows the visualization and consultation of the channels generated by the Center for Hydrographic Studies of CEDEX from the National Topographic Map 1:25,000 scale of the IGN. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Service (Web Map Service) Main Channel Network" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in OTHER. The listing shows 2013-11-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
